if: capital goods or plant and machinery are SUPPLIED
input tax credit had been taken on them
then: the registered person SHALL PAY an amount equal to the HIGHER of (i) the input tax credit taken, reduced by such percentage points as may be prescribed, and (ii) the tax on the transaction value of those capital goods or plant and machinery determined under section 15
note: Whichever is higher — not whichever the taxpayer prefers, and not the reduced credit by default. A sale of used machinery well below written-down value does not reduce the liability below the reduced credit. 'Plant and machinery' here carries the s.17 Explanation meaning; see GST-ITC-17-PM. The source is the CGST Act as updated 31-08-2021. UNKNOWN whether a later amendment has changed this provision; later amendments are not held locally.

evidence.quote: In case of supply of capital goods or plant and machinery, on which input tax credit has been taken, the registered person shall pay an amount equal to the input tax credit taken on the said capital goods or plant and machinery reduced by such percentage points as may be prescribed or the tax on the transaction value of such capital goods or plant and machinery determined under section 15, whichever is higher:
